name: coap_block
description: RFC 7959 Block1/Block2 option-value encodings and CoAP messages that carry them. Integers independently derived from RFC 7959 section 2.2: packed unsigned integer val=(NUM<<4)|(M<<3)|SZX, serialized as a 1-3 byte network-order uint (RFC 7252 section 3.2). Spec 07 section 10.5 does not recommend Block-wise on LoRa (prefer SCHC); these vectors pin the option syntax still used by OTA and gateway paths.

vectors.name: num0_m0_szx0
vectors.description: NUM=0 M=0 SZX=0 (16-byte last block). 1-byte form 0x00; RFC 7252 empty-uint is numerically equal but LICHEN rust writes one byte.

vectors.name: num0_m1_szx0
vectors.description: NUM=0 M=1 SZX=0: first 16-byte block, more follow. val=0x08.

vectors.name: num0_m0_szx3
vectors.description: NUM=0 M=0 SZX=3: 128-byte last block. RFC 7959 Figure-style 0/0/128. val=0x03.

vectors.name: num0_m1_szx2
vectors.description: NUM=0 M=1 SZX=2: first 64-byte block. val=0x0a.

vectors.name: num1_m0_szx0
vectors.description: NUM=1 M=0 SZX=0: second 16-byte last block. val=0x10.

vectors.name: num15_m0_szx6
vectors.description: NUM=15 M=0 SZX=6: last 1024-byte block still in 1-byte NUM nibble. val=0xf6.

vectors.name: num16_m0_szx0_2byte
vectors.description: NUM=16 needs 12 NUM bits so the packed int is 0x0100 (2 bytes).

vectors.name: szx7_reserved
vectors.description: SZX=7 is reserved in RFC 7959 (BERT in RFC 8323). LICHEN rejects it.

vectors.name: empty_option_value
vectors.description: Zero-length option value. RFC 7252 empty uint equals 0; LICHEN rust BlockOption requires 1-3 bytes.

vectors.name: four_byte_option_value
vectors.description: RFC 7959 option value is 0-3 bytes. Four bytes are malformed.

vectors.name: con_get_status_block2
vectors.description: CON GET /status MID 0x1234 with Block2 0/0/128 (request first 128-byte block).

vectors.name: con_put_ota_block1
vectors.description: CON PUT /ota MID 0x0002 with Block1 0/1/16 and 16-byte payload (M=1 requires full block).

vectors.name: ack_205_block2_last
vectors.description: ACK 2.05 MID 0x0001 with Block2 1/0/16 and payload hello (final block).
